legalCitations.description: Louisiana Notarial Act — notary public authority to administer oaths, take affidavits, and execute authentic acts; Louisiana notaries are quasi-judicial officers with unique powers under civil law
False swearing — criminal penalty for making a false statement under oath, including in affidavits

affidavitJurat:

_________________________________
Notary Public, State of Louisiana

My commission expires: ___________
Parish of: _______________________
Bar Roll / Notary ID: ____________

[NOTARY SEAL]

exhibitRules.instructions: Label exhibits sequentially (Exhibit A, Exhibit B, etc.) and reference each in the body of the affidavit. Attach exhibits at the end of the document.

notes: Louisiana is the only U.S. civil law jurisdiction. Its legal system derives from the French Napoleonic Code, not English common law. Louisiana uses PARISHES, not counties. Louisiana notaries are quasi-judicial officers and notarial acts carry special evidentiary weight.
